android.desc:
Read the King James Bible and build a meaningful daily Scripture habit. Discover an inspiring daily Bible verse, follow guided Bible reading plans and use Focus Mode for peaceful, distraction-free reading.

READ THE HOLY BIBLE KJV

Explore the complete King James Version of the Holy Bible in a clean and comfortable reader. Easily navigate through the Old Testament and New Testament and find any Bible book, chapter or verse.

Personalise your Bible reading experience by adjusting the font size, line spacing and reading theme.

DAILY BIBLE VERSE

Begin every day with encouragement from God’s Word. Read a carefully selected Verse of the Day, save meaningful Scriptures and share beautiful Bible verse images with friends and family.

BIBLE READING PLANS

Create a consistent Bible reading habit with guided Scripture plans. Explore:

• The Gospels
• Psalms and Proverbs
• Chronological Bible reading
• Old and New Testament plans
• Complete Bible reading journeys

Track your progress and continue reading from where you stopped.

DISTRACTION-FREE FOCUS MODE

Spend peaceful time with Scripture using Bible Focus Mode. Select a reading duration and temporarily silence distracting notifications while you read.

A built-in Bible reading timer helps you stay focused during quiet time, personal devotion and daily Bible study.

HIGHLIGHTS, BOOKMARKS AND NOTES

Make your KJV Bible personal:

• Highlight meaningful Bible verses
• Bookmark chapters and passages
• Save favourite Scriptures
• Write personal Bible study notes
• Return to important verses anytime

PEACEFUL DEVOTIONAL MUSIC

Create a calm atmosphere for Bible reading, prayer and reflection with gentle piano, ambient sounds and devotional instrumental music.

COMFORTABLE READING THEMES

Choose the reading experience that feels right for you:

• Clean light theme
• Warm sepia theme
• Eye-friendly dark mode
• Adjustable font size
• Customisable line spacing

Dark Mode makes nighttime Bible reading more comfortable, while Focus Mode helps keep your quiet time free from interruptions.

BUILD A DAILY SCRIPTURE HABIT

Holy Bible KJV is designed for Christians who want to:

• Read the King James Bible daily
• Receive an inspiring daily Bible verse
• Follow structured Bible reading plans
• Study Scripture with notes and highlights
• Enjoy peaceful, distraction-free Bible reading
• Strengthen their relationship with God’s Word
